name: ULTRABALATON
organizer: Balatonman Triatlon Kft & FULLCON IT Development Kft
price_range: 18 500 Ft/fő (7-13 fős csapat), 19 500 Ft/fő (egyéb csapatok), csapatonként 40 000 Ft
description: Ultrabalaton 2026 will be held for the 20th time, Hungary's most popular community sports event. The race is a single lap around Lake Balaton, which is the longest running race in Central Europe, and can be completed individually or in teams of 2-6 people, either running or cycling. The distance is 209 kilometers, available for individual participants and teams of 2 to 6 members. The event has a friendly, community atmosphere and offers attractive programs for runners, supporters, and cyclists.
course_highlights: 209-kilometer single lap around Lake Balaton
Longest running race in Central Europe
Opportunity to participate individually or in teams of 2-6 members
additional: Race office address: 1134 Budapest, Tüzér utca 9-11, opening hours Monday and Tuesday 10:00-13:00. Support available for competitors through #PROJEKT418, refreshment points, and stage calculator in the StafetApp. There are also programs for supporters and cyclists. The registration deadline is September 27, 2025. The race will take place from April 23 to 26, 2026, with the start on April 25, 2026. Participants can pick up their race kits at the race center, and the lap time calculator is available in the StafetApp.

name: Crosul de noapte
description: Crosul de Noapte - Delonghi este o cursă de alergare organizată în Cluj-Napoca, care oferă participanților două distanțe: 4 km și 10 km. Evenimentul se desfășoară pe 8 mai 2026 și este potrivit pentru alergători de toate nivelurile care doresc să se bucure de o experiență sportivă nocturnă în oraș. Este o oportunitate excelentă de a alerga într-un cadru urban, într-o atmosferă prietenoasă și competitivă.
course_highlights: Distanțe de 4 km și 10 km
Alergare nocturnă în Cluj-Napoca
Traseu urban accesibil pentru toate nivelurile
additional: Evenimentul include trasee bine marcate, posibilitate de înscriere online și un mediu sigur pentru participanți.

name: Турнир ”Цветанка Христова”
description: The 'Tsvetanka Hristova' tournament is an annual athletics competition held in memory of one of Bulgaria's greatest athletes. The competition is organized for the 17th time and includes the second round of the youth athletics series 'A1 Athletics for Youth'. The tournament takes place at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia and gathers athletes of various ages and disciplines. It is an important event in Bulgarian athletics that honors the legacy of Tsvetanka Hristova and encourages the development of young talents.
course_highlights: Held at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia
Includes the second round of the 'A1 Athletics for Youth' series
Memorial tournament in honor of Olympic medalist Tsvetanka Hristova
additional: athletics competitions, youth rounds, memorial tournament

name: La Petrovaselo în vie

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Taxă de participare pentru Bendis (5 km) până la 19 aprilie 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Taxă de participare pentru Ovas (14 km) până la 19 aprilie 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Taxă de participare pentru PV Grand Cru (28 km) până la 19 aprilie 2026

description: La Petrovaselo în vie este un eveniment sportiv dedicat alergării în natură, organizat pentru a promova un stil de viață sănătos și pentru a crește numărul practicanților de alergare în aer liber. Evenimentul, organizat de Clubul Sportiv Asociația Alergotura în parteneriat cu Petro Vaselo Winery, oferă trei curse de alergare cu distanțe variate, desfășurate pe trasee pitorești în zona viei Petro Vaselo. Participanții se pot bucura de o experiență sportivă în natură, cu trasee bine marcate și puncte de alimentare, într-un cadru prietenos și organizat. După cursă, participanții sunt invitați să se relaxeze cu gulaș și vin, oferite pe baza numărului de concurs.
course_highlights: Trasee de alergare în natură prin vie, cu distanțe de 5 km, 14 km și 28 km
Traseul de 28 km constă în parcurgerea de două ori a traseului de 14 km, a doua buclă fiind în sens invers
Traseele sunt semnalizate cu bandă și indicatoare, cu voluntari la punctele de schimbare a direcției
additional: Participanții trebuie să ajungă cu cel puțin 30 de minute înainte de start la Crama Petrovaselo. Startul curselor de 14 km și 28 km este la 09:00, iar cursa de 5 km începe la 09:15. Există limită de timp pentru finish pentru fiecare cursă (5 km - 10:15, 14 km - 11:05, 28 km - 13:00). După cursă, participanții primesc gulaș și vin pe baza numărului de concurs. Traseele pot avea zone cu noroi în funcție de condițiile meteo. Transferul între curse este permis înainte de start, în limita locurilor disponibile. Participanții pot înscrie și verifica lista participanților online; evenimentul combină sportul cu peisajele viticole din zona Recaș.

name: The Color Run București
description: The Color Run București este o cursă de 5 km necronometrată, plină de culoare și energie, care celebrează sănătatea, bucuria și originalitatea. Participanții pornesc în haine albe și sunt colorați cu pudră colorată la fiecare kilometru, culminând cu o petrecere vibrantă la final. Evenimentul are loc pe 25 aprilie 2026 în București, pe traseul Bd. Unirii și zonele adiacente, oferind o experiență festivă și accesibilă tuturor vârstelor. Este o sărbătoare a mișcării și comunității, cu momente speciale precum norul de pudră colorată și muzică live.
course_highlights: Traseu de 5 km pe Bd. Unirii și zonele adiacente din București
Puncte de colorare cu pudră la fiecare kilometru parcurs
Momentul norului de pudră colorată la final, acompaniat de muzică
additional: Ridicarea kiturilor se face la Mega Mall București între 18 și 24 aprilie, cu program extins. Evenimentul începe cu acces în zona de eveniment la ora 12:00, starturile sunt succesive între 14:00 și 14:20, iar la ora 16:00-16:15 are loc norul de pudră colorată. Copiii 0-6 ani pot participa gratuit fără kit, iar înscrierea multipla este posibilă prin adăugarea participanților în formular. Evenimentul este necronometrat și deschis tuturor vârstelor, inclusiv persoanelor cu dizabilități care beneficiază de acces gratuit. Traseul include zone urbane; înscrierea include medalii și pudră colorată; evenimentul are mai multe valuri de start și puncte de ridicare a kiturilor.

name: Maratonul Codrului
description: Maratonul Codrului, ediția a V-a, este un eveniment organizat de Club Sportiv Pro Racers și Federația Română de Ciclism, ce va avea loc pe 25 aprilie 2026 la Lacul Oţeloaia, Satu Mare. Este o competiție dedicată atât amatorilor, cât și profesioniștilor, cu probe MTB și Trail Run pe trasee spectaculoase prin pădure, cu provocări pentru toate nivelurile. Evenimentul oferă trasee noi și mai provocatoare la probele MTB, precum și probe hobby cu trasee scurte pentru a încuraja participarea. De asemenea, există o cursă specială pentru copii, iar participanții beneficiază de pachet de start, cronometrare, puncte de hidratare, asistență medicală, pasta party și medalii de finisher.
course_highlights: Trasee MTB noi, mai provocatoare, fără partea de șosea din ultimii 5 km
Trasee Trail Run variate, de la 6 km la 43.5 km, cu urcări semnificative
Kids Race dedicată copiilor, cu traseu de 2 km și 70 m diferență de nivel
additional: Taxa de participare include pachet de start cu număr de concurs și produse ale sponsorilor, fotografii de pe traseu, puncte de hidratare pe traseu și la finish, serviciu de urgențe medicale și Salvamont, cronometrare, medalie de finisher și pasta party. Traseele pot suferi modificări până la data concursului. Trasee pentru MTB și Trail Run, categorii de vârstă, înscrieri online, medalii finisher, tricouri tehnice, eveniment pentru familie și comunitate

name: Forest Race Marghita
location: Str. Tudor Vladimirescu Nr.73, Marghita, Bihor County, Romania
description: Forest Race Marghita este o competiție de alergare pe traseu accidentat, cu dificultate medie, desfășurată în pădurea foioasă din apropierea orașului Marghita. Evenimentul este organizat de Clubul Sportiv Run For Freedom împreună cu Clubul Sportiv XTERRA Sport Bihor și oferă patru trasee diferite, adaptate pentru diverse niveluri de alergători. Startul și finish-ul sunt în Parcul de Aventură Freedom, iar traseele sunt bine marcate pe drumuri forestiere. Concursul promovează un stil de viață sănătos și respectul pentru mediul înconjurător.
course_highlights: Trasee pe drumuri forestiere marcate corespunzător
Diferențe de nivel moderate: 460 m pentru semimaraton, 230 m pentru cross, 20 m pentru mini
Start și finish în Parcul de Aventură Freedom
additional: Tricoul oficial nu este inclus în preț și nu se poate comanda prin înscriere; costul tricoului este 100 lei, achiziționat separat. Participanții sub 18 ani trebuie să prezinte adeverință medicală și acord parental. Organizatorii pot retrage concurenții aflați în stare de ebrietate sau fără echipament corespunzător. Înscrierea se face exclusiv prin webshopul oficial. Trasee de trail running în pădure, trei rute diferite, organizat de cluburi sportive locale, prima ediție în primăvara anului 2022

name: RotaRUN for Charity
price_range: taxa de înscriere (specific amount not provided)
description: RotaRUN for Charity este un eveniment sportiv și caritabil organizat de Rotary Club Cluj-Napoca, care combină alergarea cu implicarea comunității pentru a susține renovarea secției de Oncologie Pediatrică a Institutului Oncologic „Prof. dr. Ion Chiricuță” din Cluj-Napoca. Evenimentul din 25 aprilie 2026 include curse de 3 km, 9 km și o cursă de 2 ore, oferind participanților oportunitatea de a alerga pentru o cauză nobilă și de a contribui la crearea unui mediu modern și primitor pentru copiii bolnavi de cancer. Participanții beneficiază de kit de participare cu tricou, număr și cip de cronometrare, precum și acces la puncte de hidratare și alimentare. Toate fondurile colectate din taxele de înscriere sunt direcționate către finalizarea renovării secției de Oncopediatrie.
course_highlights: Traseu de alergare pe Promenada Someșului, Cluj-Napoca
Cros 3 km (un tur de circuit) și RotaRun 9 km (3 tururi de circuit)
Long Run - cursa de rezistență de 2 ore
additional: Mărimea tricoului este garantată pentru înscrierile până la 10 aprilie 2026; după această dată, mărimile vor fi alocate în ordinea înscrierilor, în limita disponibilității. Participanții primesc număr de concurs și cip de cronometrare, acces la puncte de hidratare și alimentare cu alimente dulci și sărate, băuturi izotonice și suplimente. Vor fi premiați primii 3 clasați masculin și feminin la fiecare probă, atât la categoria Open, cât și pe categorii de vârstă. Evenimentul include și sprijin pentru achiziția de mobilier și echipamente medicale moderne pentru secția de oncopediatrie, fiind un proiect de fundraising și conștientizare comunitară.

name: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom
description: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom este primul concurs de Mountain Bike cu scop caritabil din România, ajuns la a 14-a ediție. Evenimentul se desfășoară în localitatea Urlați, județul Prahova, pe 25 aprilie 2026, printre dealurile, podgoriile și cramele din zonă. Participanții pot alege între mai multe trasee adaptate nivelului lor, de la 4 km pentru copii până la 50 km pentru cicliști experimentați. Concursul promovează ciclismul ca stil de viață sănătos și susține cauze sociale importante.
course_highlights: Traseu de 50 km pentru cicliști experimentați
Traseu de 30 km pentru amatori și juniori
Traseu de 18 km recomandat cicliștilor mai puțin experimentați
additional: Startul pentru copii (4 și 8 km) este la ora 09:00, pentru traseele de 18, 30 și 50 km la 10:35, iar pentru plimbarea Family la 10:45. Ridicarea pachetelor se face în București și la fața locului în intervale orare specifice. Participanții de la Tura Family nu primesc kit de concurs și pot merge direct la start. Ceremonia de premiere este programată la ora 15:00, iar timpul limită de sosire este 16:30. Evenimentul include și activități pentru familii și copii, precum și sprijin pentru cauze sociale și educaționale, promovând cultura vinului și turismul local.

name: RotaRun 2026
description: RotaRun for Charity este un eveniment sportiv și caritabil organizat de Rotary Club Cluj-Napoca, care combină alergarea cu implicarea comunității pentru a sprijini copiii bolnavi de cancer. Evenimentul din 25 aprilie 2026 are ca scop finalizarea renovării secției de Oncologie Pediatrică a Institutului Oncologic „Prof. dr. Ion Chiricuță” din Cluj-Napoca. Participanții pot alege între mai multe curse, de la un cros de 3 km până la o cursă de 2 ore, toate desfășurate pe Promenada Someșului, cu start și sosire în zona Sălii Sporturilor „Horia Demian”. Fondurile colectate din taxele de înscriere sunt direcționate integral către proiectul caritabil.
course_highlights: Traseu pe Promenada Someșului în Cluj-Napoca
Cros 3 km (un tur de circuit) și RotaRun 9 km (3 tururi de circuit)
Long Run - cursa de 2 ore cu distanța maximă parcursă
additional: Mărimea tricoului este garantată pentru înscrierile până la 10 aprilie 2026, după care se alocă în limita disponibilității. Participanții primesc număr de concurs și cip de cronometrare, acces la puncte de hidratare și alimentare, precum și fotografii la start/finish și pe traseu. Vor fi premiați primii 3 clasați masculin și feminin la fiecare probă, atât la categoria Open, cât și pe categorii de vârstă. Evenimentul sprijină renovarea secției de Oncologie Pediatrică, cu detalii despre traseu și înscrieri urmate să fie anunțate în curând

description: La Petrovaselo în vie este un eveniment sportiv dedicat alergării în natură, organizat pentru a promova un stil de viață sănătos și pentru a crește numărul alergătorilor în aer liber. Evenimentul are loc în Recaș, România, și cuprinde trei curse de alergare pe trasee pitorești în vie, cu distanțe de 5 km, 14 km și 28 km. Participanții se bucură de o atmosferă prietenoasă, susținută de comunitate și parteneri locali, cu puncte de alimentare și o socializare plăcută după cursă. Traseele sunt bine marcate și adaptate pentru confort și siguranță, iar evenimentul este organizat cu sprijinul autorităților locale și al sponsorilor.
course_highlights: Trasee în natură prin vie, cu distanțe de 5 km, 14 km și 28 km
Traseul de 28 km constă în parcurgerea de două ori a traseului de 14 km, a doua buclă fiind în sens invers
Traseele sunt semnalizate cu bandă și indicatoare, cu voluntari la punctele de schimbare a direcției
additional: Participanții trebuie să ajungă cu cel puțin 30 de minute înainte de start la Crama Petrovaselo. Kiturile de participare sunt limitate la 1000 în total, cu alocări specifice pe curse. După cursă, participanții pot savura gulaș și vin pe baza numărului de concurs. Traseele pot avea zone cu noroi în funcție de condițiile meteo. Transferul între curse este permis înainte de start, în limita locurilor disponibile. Evenimentul include activități de trail și curse culturale, cu participare deschisă pentru toate nivelurile de alergători. Înscrierile și detaliile despre curse sunt disponibile online.

name: 140 BPM - 25 aprilie 2026
location: Parcul Regele Mihai I (Herăstrău), București, Romania
description: 140 BPM este o cursă de alergare organizată în Parcul Regele Mihai I (Herăstrău) din București, programată pentru 25 aprilie 2026. Evenimentul oferă trasee adaptate pentru toate vârstele, inclusiv curse pentru copii și adulți, pe distanțe de 3 km și 6 km. Traseele sunt concepute pentru a fi accesibile și plăcute, desfășurându-se pe aleile parcului, oferind o experiență recreativă și competitivă în aer liber. Participanții se pot bucura de o atmosferă prietenoasă și de facilități dedicate alergătorilor.
course_highlights: Traseu de 3 km pentru copii (Melci / Iepurași) - o tură de 1,5 km dus-întors
Traseu de 6 km pentru adulți (Țestoase) - o tură de 6 km
Locația în Parcul Regele Mihai I (Herăstrău), un cadru natural urban atractiv
additional: Cursa copiilor este pe un traseu scurt, 1,5 km dus-întors, iar cursa pentru adulți este o tură de 6 km. Evenimentul are o tradiție cu ediții anterioare în același parc, cu galerii foto și rezultate disponibile online. Evenimentul include și rezultate și galerii foto din edițiile anterioare, fiind o oportunitate de a socializa și de a promova un stil de viață activ.

name: Mozdulj Csepel!
location: Kolonics György Szabadidőközpont, Hollandi út 8-10, Budapest, Hungary
description: Mozdulj, Csepel! is a free family running race organized by the Municipality of Csepel as part of the Active Csepel series. The race starts at the beautiful Csepel Danube bank, from the György Kolonics Leisure Center, and offers four distances for movement: 3.5 km, 7 km, 400 m children's run, and a special race for people with disabilities. The goal of the race is to share the community experience and the joy of movement for all ages, with an environmentally conscious approach and cup-free refreshments. Wearing a bib number is mandatory for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances, and chip timing ensures accurate results.
course_highlights: The race route runs along Kolonics promenade, on the Danube bank
Chip timing and absolute male and female podiums for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances
The children's run route passes under the two-arched bridge, with parental supervision allowed
additional: The event is cup-free, so participants are advised to use their own softcup, bottle, or cup. Medals are awarded to the youngest participants, while older runners receive a gym bag, an apple, and muesli at the finish line. Starting with a stroller is only permitted at your own risk. The special race for people with disabilities is a joyful run where walking and strolling are also allowed. Multiple distances require registration, environmentally friendly chip timing, awards, family and special categories, route along the Danube, outdoor event, rain or sunshine.

name: Galbicska Péter Emlékfutás Tata 7 / 14
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The VI. Galbicska Péter Memorial Run will be held on April 25, 2026, in Tata, at the Tópart promenade. The race offers two distances: 7 km (one lap around the lake) and 14 km (two laps). Runners can register according to age groups and gender. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, taking place in the scenic lakeside environment, providing both a challenge and an experience for participants. The start begins at 10:00 AM, and registration is open until 6:00 PM on April 23.
course_highlights: 7 km and 14 km lakeside loops
Scenic Tata Tópart promenade environment
Category and gender-specific race distances
additional: Registration requires filling out mandatory fields, with separate registration codes for each age group and gender. Registration is conducted online, with fees payable via bank card or transfer through the SimplePay system. The registration deadline is April 23 at 18:00. Multiple categories participate in the race, and registration is necessary to take part, closing on April 23. The event is part of Tata's sports life and traditions.

description: The Backyard Ultra Esztergom 2026 is a special ultramarathon race that continues until the last person is left. Participants complete a 6706-meter loop every hour, and only those who finish before the next start remain in the race. The event is part of the Hungarian Backyard League and is organized as a age-group championship, where the best female and male runners are awarded in 11 age categories. The race takes place at Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya in Esztergom, and participants who complete up to 160 kilometers also receive recognition.
course_highlights: 6706-meter loop that must be completed every hour
Race until the last person, who finishes before the next start
Age-group championship in 11 categories for both women and men
additional: The race is part of the Hungarian Backyard League and is organized as an age-group championship, awarding the best female and male runners in 11 categories. Entry fees can be paid by credit card or bank transfer, with an invoice sent in case of bank transfer. The Backyard MINI race includes 6 laps (40.236 km), where the fastest female and male runners are awarded gold medals. Participants can earn multiple medals and trophies. On-site registration is possible depending on available spots at a higher price. The race location is Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya, with detailed registration and prize information available on the official website. The event celebrates endurance and community, allowing runners to push their limits.

name: Асеновградски Баири
description: Asenovgrad Bairi is a competition and festival that combines sport and entertainment in the nature of Asenovgrad and the Rhodope Mountains. The event includes mountain running and cycling, held on two separate days, allowing participants and guests to enjoy the nature and sights of the region. Organized by the Association "ASENOVGRADSKI BAIRI", the competition offers various distances for runners and cyclists, suitable for different ages and levels of fitness. Participation requires good physical condition and appropriate equipment, and the event is aimed at sports and nature enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with control points and time limits for long distances
Running and cycling disciplines on two separate days
Opportunity to visit sights and evening entertainment between the days
additional: The competition includes children's starts on short distances, control times, and stops at certain kilometers for the long runs (47 km and 80 km). For cycling, there are different distances from 0.5 km to 60 km. The event takes place at the square "Acad. N. Haitov" in Asenovgrad. Participants should be prepared for mountain conditions and risks, including fatigue and bad weather. The disciplines include mountain running and cycling with various distances; the competition has participation regulations, including equipment and physical preparation; online registration is available, and there are different categories for participants.

name: Национален шампионат 10 000м - писта
description: The National Championship for 10,000 meters on track in Hisarya is a prestigious race organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. This championship brings together the best Bulgarian athletes competing in the classic 10-kilometer track distance. The event is part of the federation's sports calendar for 2026 and highlights the traditions and development of athletics in Bulgaria.
course_highlights: Track race with a classic distance of 10,000 meters
Held in the city of Hisarya
Part of the national sports calendar of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation
additional: The first national championship in Hisarya for 10,000 meters on track is included in the sports calendar for 2026.

name: Студентско бягане "UNIRUN"
description: UNIRUN is a student running event in Sofia that combines sports with a social cause, supporting youth sports and shelters without cages. The event takes place in West Park and offers four distances with varying difficulty - from 1 km to a half marathon of 21 km. Participants join a community that inspires movement, healthy living, and social engagement, while having fun with music, games, and prizes. The run is accompanied by festival activities and opportunities for personal development and social contacts.
course_highlights: Terrain 50% asphalt and 50% park alleys with gravel
Checkpoints at different kilometers depending on the distance
Festival village with interactive tents and music
additional: Start number distribution will be held from April 21 to 23, from 9:00 to 19:00 in the South wing of the rectorate. Each distance has an official warm-up and an award ceremony. Games, raffles, and opportunities for social contacts and professional feedback are included. Official T-shirts and other merchandise with a cause to support youth sports. Distances: 1 km, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km; support for social causes such as helping children with cerebral palsy and animals; an event with an active community and numerous prizes.

name: Semimaraton Iași
organizer: Rotary Club Iași Copou, Salvați Copiii Iași, Primăria Municipiului Iași

price_tiers.distance: Cursa populară, Cursa copiilor, Cursa persoanelor cu dizabilități

description: Semimaraton Iași este cel mai mare eveniment de alergare din Nord-Estul României, desfășurat anual în Piața Palatului Culturii. Traseul semimaratonului constă în două bucle cu trecere prin zona de start, oferind alergătorilor o experiență unică pe străzile principale ale orașului, cu oprirea circulației auto și puncte de revitalizare. Evenimentul are o puternică componentă caritabilă, susținând copii din medii defavorizate prin proiecte educaționale și sociale. Participarea la cursele de semimaraton, cros și curse populare este o ocazie de a face o faptă bună și de a face parte dintr-o comunitate dedicată schimbării pozitive.
course_highlights: Traseu pe străzi principale cu oprirea circulației auto
Trecere prin fața Palatului Culturii
Puncte de revitalizare pentru hidratare și asistență medicală
additional: Participanții la cursele de semimaraton, cros 10 km și cros 5 km primesc cip de unică folosință și tricou tehnic de participare. Înscrierile se pot face online până la data limită, iar după aceasta, în funcție de locurile disponibile, se pot face înscrieri offline la insula Semimaraton Iași din Palas Mall. Nu se pot face înscrieri în ziua concursului. Evenimentul oferă ambulanță pentru asistență medicală și multe fotografii la finish și pe traseu. Participarea include puncte de hidratare, asistență medicală, kit de participare și posibilitatea de a participa online sau offline. Evenimentul are scop caritabil, susținând proiecte pentru copiii defavorizați.

name: Bucharest International Half Marathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Taxa de participare se poate achita ONLINE cu cardul bancar până la data de 12 APRILIE 2026.

description: Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță este o cursă internațională de semimaraton ce se desfășoară pe cele mai frumoase și rapide străzi din București, oferind oportunitatea unui record personal competitiv atât pentru atleții profesioniști, cât și pentru alergătorii amatori. Evenimentul include și curse de 10 km, curse pentru persoane cu dizabilități locomotorii și o cursă populară de 3,5 km pentru toate vârstele. Kitul de participare conține număr de concurs cu chip timing și medalie pentru finishers, iar tricoul oficial este opțional. Organizatorul este Asociația Club Sportiv Constantina Diță, iar evenimentul este susținut de parteneri importanți precum Decathlon.
course_highlights: Traseu plat și rapid pe străzile principale ale Bucureștiului
Cursă certificată World Athletics Label pentru semimaraton
Trasee dedicate pentru semimaraton, 10 km, persoane cu dizabilități și cursă populară
additional: Kit-ul de participare se ridică exclusiv în persoană la Expo pe baza actului de identitate. Tricoul oficial este opțional și se poate achiziționa separat la prețul de 15 EUR. Participarea persoanelor în fotolii rulante este gratuită. Timpul maxim pentru semimaraton este de 3 ore, iar pentru cursa de 10 km este de 1.5 ore. Unele străzi vor fi închise pe durata evenimentului, recomandându-se folosirea transportului în comun, în special metroul până la stația Aviatorilor. Traseul include opțiuni pentru alergare și mers, cu posibilitatea de a participa la recorduri; evenimentul include și alte curse precum 10 km și ștafete.

name: URME PE PLAY
price_range: prima înscriere este gratuită, alte detalii nu sunt specificate
description: Urme pe Play este o competiție de alergare montană ce se desfășoară în comuna Rășinari, la poalele munților Cindrel și Lotru. Traseele sunt marcate și includ poteci naturale, drumuri forestiere și asfalt, oferind o experiență submontană autentică. Evenimentul este deschis atât adulților, cât și copiilor, cu curse dedicate pentru fiecare categorie de vârstă. Participanții se pot bucura de peisaje pitorești și de atmosfera prietenoasă a comunității locale în cadrul unui eveniment ce combină sportul cu cultura și tradiția locală.
course_highlights: Trasee pe poteci marcate în Rășinari și dealurile de la poalele munților Cindrel și Lotru
Suprafață variată: asfalt, drum forestier, poteci naturale și pășuni
Peisaje pitorești de primăvară la poalele munților
additional: Participarea se face pe proprie răspundere, cu semnarea unei declarații de responsabilitate. Vârsta minimă este 14 ani pentru cursa Fuguț și 18 ani pentru Cros, Semi, Maraton și Ultra Maraton. Copiii sub 14 ani pot participa la curse dedicate. Pachetul de înscriere nu se expediază prin poștă. Organizatorul poate interzice startul sau continuarea cursei în caz de stare fizică necorespunzătoare. Evenimentul include și activități culturale, drumeții și târg cu produse locale, fiind o oportunitate de a descoperi tradițiile și frumusețea zonei Rășinari.

name: IX. Miklósi Futónap
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 8 km, 3.5 km, 1 km, 0.8 km, 0.5 km
description: The 9th Miklósi Running Day is a family-friendly running race held in Szigetszentmiklós, scheduled for April 26, 2026. The race offers multiple distances, ranging from 500 meters up to a half marathon (21 km). The event starts in front of the City Sports Hall and follows the route along Szebeni Road, Petőfi Road, and Gerincút, then returns to the sports hall. Participants will have access to changing rooms, a cloakroom, and restrooms at the venue. The goal of the race is to promote sports and community engagement for all ages.
course_highlights: Route starting and returning to the City Sports Hall
Route along Szebeni Road - Petőfi Road - Gerincút
Distances: 500 m, 800 m, 1000 m, 3.5 km, 8 km, 21 km (half marathon)
additional: Race packet pickup and information point at the entrance of the City Sports Hall. Changing rooms, cloakroom, and restrooms are available inside the Sports Hall. Same-day registration and on-site personal registration are not available. Registration is only possible online via credit card payment through the Barion system. Children under 6 years old may participate in the 500 m distance only if accompanied by an adult. The number of participants may be limited by the organizers. The event offers categories for various age groups and runner types. Participation requires online registration. The event includes timing, refreshment stations, and parking options.

name: III. Strázsa-hegyi Trail Futóverseny 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
location: Monor, Strázsahegyi dűlő, Pest County, Hungary
description: The III. Strázsa-hegyi Toyota Kovács Trail Running Race will be held on April 26, 2026, in Monor, in the Strázsahegy area. Participants can choose from a 500-meter family run, as well as 2, 5, 10 kilometers, and half marathon distances. The runners will complete the courses on varied terrain in a natural environment, including 10 km and half marathon routes. The event aims to promote the love of sport and nature in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Natural trail routes around Monor
10 km and half marathon distances available
Family run of 500 meters for the youngest participants
additional: Registrations are accepted until April 12. The .gpx maps of the 10 km and half marathon routes are available on the official race website. Online registration is possible, route maps (.gpx format) are accessible, and the event features a family-friendly atmosphere with local food and wine for participants.

name: STRÁZSA-HEGYI TRAIL
location: Szent Orbán tér, Monor, Pest County, Hungary
description: The III. Strázsa-hegy Toyota Kovács Trail Running Race will be held on April 26, 2026, in Monor, at Szent Orbán Square. This is the third time that competitors can test their strength around the picturesque Strázsa Hill on varied terrain. The race offers a challenging trail route in a family-friendly, natural environment for all participants. The event is organized in the spirit of sport and community experience, welcoming running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Natural, varied terrain around Strázsa Hill
Challenging trail running routes
Start location at Monor, Szent Orbán Square
additional: The race takes place on April 26, 2026, between 08:00 and 15:00 in Monor, at Szent Orbán Square. The event is part of the Toyota Kovács Trail Running Race series and is held for the third time. Chip timing, free bus services, and parking options are provided. The registration deadline is April 12.

name: ÍROTTKŐ HILLCLIMB
location: Kőszeg Rőtfalva, Kőszeg, Vas County, Hungary
description: The Írottkő Hillclimb is a diverse and memorable mountain running race scheduled for April 26, 2026, near Kőszeg Rőtfalva. The race starts from a new location in Bozsok and offers challenges at various distances, from a 7 km introductory trail run to the 102 km Alpokalja Ultra. The courses traverse varied terrain, with beautiful panoramas and refreshment points, requiring endurance and good physical conditioning from participants. The event also features family-friendly programs, allowing even the youngest to enjoy nature conservation and interactive exhibitions.
course_highlights: New starting point in Bozsok for the development of the race
23 km distance with 780 meters of elevation, with a panoramic view from the top of Írottkő
102 km Alpokalja Ultra, through the most scenic spots of the Kőszeg Mountains
additional: The race starts from a new location in Bozsok, with multiple refreshment and water points along the course. The 23 km distance includes 780 meters of elevation gain, offering panoramic views from the summit of Írottkő. The 102 km course can be completed in teams, providing a unique experience of crossing the finish line together. Interactive exhibitions and nature conservation programs await the youngest participants. The race is semi-self-sufficient, requiring mandatory equipment such as a mobile phone, water container, windproof or rain jacket, headlamp, and spare batteries. The event showcases the natural beauty of the Kőszeg Mountains, with varied terrain, starting from Bozsok, and provides opportunities for different age groups and skill levels to participate.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: The Futapest Mountain Running Race in Bér is an exciting trail running event held in the picturesque surroundings of Bér, Virágospuszta. Runners can test their strength on diverse, nature-close routes, enjoying the beauty of nature and the challenging terrain. The race is organized by the Futapest Club, which has been supporting trail running and cross-country sports in Hungary for many years. All runners are welcome to participate in a friendly, community-oriented running event.
course_highlights: Nature-close, diverse terrain around Bér, Virágospuszta
Challenging hilly sections and forest trails
Scenic landscape and fresh air for runners
additional: The race offers different distances for participation, and the event is aimed at nature enthusiasts and sports lovers. Detailed information can be found on the website.

name: Pancharevo Trail Marathon
description: Pancharevo Trail Marathon is the largest spring mountain running event in Bulgaria, held near Lake Pancharevo. The race offers three distances - 42 km marathon with 1700 meters of elevation gain, 21 km half marathon with 700 meters of elevation gain to Bachun Peak, and 10 km suitable for beginners, as well as a 15 km mountain hike. The routes pass through the picturesque Lozenska Mountain with views of Vitosha, Stara Planina, Rila, and the Iskar Reservoir. The event is organized by the sports club "Begach" and attracts more participants each year.
course_highlights: 42 km marathon with 1700 m elevation gain through Lozenska Mountain
21 km half marathon with 700 m elevation gain to Bachun Peak
10 km routes with about 100 m elevation change, suitable for beginners
additional: Start packages are collected on Thursday and Friday before the race in Sofia. Support stations and medical assistance are available along the routes. The event does not provide cups; participants must bring their own bottle or cup for water. A wardrobe is available, but organizers are not responsible for lost items. Free parking is available in Pancharevo. Medical teams are present at the start, Pasarel, and Lalina Mogila. Participants must wear a bib on the chest or stomach. Multiple race categories, including mountain running and hikes; an event focused on nature and social activities; date April 26, 2026.

name: XL kmrun - Банкя
description: XL Bankya is a new race from the XLkmrun calendar, taking place in the foothills of the Lyulin Mountain near Sofia. The course is in the shape of an eight, starting from the northern outskirts of Bankya and leading to the Ostra Chuka peak. Participants can choose between two distances - 6.4 km with 217 meters of positive elevation gain or 12.8 km, with the course offering challenges for mountain running enthusiasts. The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various courses and distances in Sofia and other cities.
course_highlights: The course is in the shape of an eight starting from the northern outskirts of Bankya
Per lap length of 6.4 km with 217 meters of positive elevation gain
Option to choose between one or two laps (6.4 km or 12.8 km)
additional: The course is the idea of Miroslav Spasov. The race is organized at the location of the spring relay. Part of the 5kmrun calendar with other events in Sofia and the country. Race in the foothills of Lyulin Mountain, date 2026-04-26

name: Бистрица Вертикал Рън
description: Bistritsa Vertical Run is a picturesque and challenging race that starts from the village of Bistritsa, accessible by public transport. The course passes through diverse terrain with smooth but demanding ascents, reaching the Kikiš area with panoramic views of Sofia. The route continues to the Kamен del hut, where participants can refresh themselves with food and drinks. This race is an excellent training for strength and endurance, suitable for preparing for long distances and mountain running.
course_highlights: Start from the village of Bistritsa with easy access by bus №98
Smooth but demanding ascent with 500 m positive elevation to the Kikiš area
Panoramic views of Sofia and the opportunity for rest and support at the Kamен del hut
additional: The route includes a variety of surfaces - from forest trails to rocky sections, which helps adaptation to different conditions. In the Kikiš shelter area, shelter and food are available on weekends. Running in nature provides recovery away from city noise. terrain, marathon preparation, natural environment

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване за мъже и жени и юноши и девойки под 20 г.
description: The National Mountain Running Championship - uphill for men, women, juniors, and under 20s will be held on April 26, 2026, in Sofia, Bistritsa village. The event is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and offers a challenging mountain run with an uphill course, suitable for various age groups. Organizers provide official registration and support for the competitors, with communication conducted directly with them. The event is traditional and attracts athletes seeking a competitive experience in mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Mountain running with uphill course in the Bistritsa village area, Sofia
Race for men, women, juniors, and under 20s
Held under the auspices of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation
additional: Contact with the organizer is recommended for all inquiries. The race is part of the national mountain running championship and takes place in Bistritsa village, Sofia. It is part of the national mountain running series with a focus on uphill running, providing opportunities for participation across different age groups.

description: Alergăraș în Făgăraș este un eveniment sportiv care aduce laolaltă alergători de toate vârstele și nivelurile de performanță pentru a explora frumusețea naturală și culturală a zonei Făgărașului. Traseele oferă o experiență completă, cu urcări abrupte, coborâri prin peisaje spectaculoase și puncte de hidratare bine organizate, iar startul și finish-ul se desfășoară în apropierea cetății istorice. Atmosfera este una prietenoasă și motivantă, susținută de o comunitate entuziastă și voluntari dedicați. Evenimentul promovează sportul de masă și respectul pentru natură, oferind o zi memorabilă de alergare și socializare în mijlocul peisajelor montane.
course_highlights: Urcări abrupte și coborâri prin peisaje spectaculoase
Start și finish în zona cetății Făgăraș
Puncte de hidratare bogate și marcaj foarte bun
additional: Medalie premium de finisher, premii în bani pentru podiumuri, puncte ITRA și index UTMB pentru cursele Maratonu’ de pe Ardeal și Belvedere, voucher masă caldă după cursă, asistență medicală cu ambulanță, cort de masaj, puncte de alimentare și hidratare pe traseu și la finish, opțiune pentru tricou tehnic de alergare contra cost. Multiple categorii de curse, inclusiv maraton, trail, cros și ștafete; evenimentul include activități culturale și turistice, promovând un stil de viață sănătos și frumusețile naturale ale zonei Făgărașului.

name: Etyekrun
organizer: RUNaway Sportszervező Kft. és Etyek Trend
description: The EtyekRUN is a special running race on the slopes of Etyek, where the atmosphere of the wine region, vineyards, and spring scenery accompany participants every step of the way. The race is part of the Garmin WTF series, which celebrates the joy of movement and the diversity of performances, whether shorter asphalt or longer trail running distances. The event is family-friendly, emphasizing sustainability, consistency, and joy within the community. Participants will experience a unique adventure amidst the beauty of nature and the wine region.
course_highlights: Route through the slopes, vineyards, and ditches of Etyek
Spring scenery and wine region atmosphere
Mixed terrain: asphalt and trail running
additional: Family registration options are available at a discounted price, where one adult can register up to 5 family members. Family registration is initially medal-free, but a medal can be ordered for an additional fee. Registration is non-refundable but can be transferred to another race at least 21 days before the event. The registration system automatically sends an invoice, and multiple payment methods are available. The Garmin WTF series emphasizes sustainability and community experience. Participants can choose from various distances, and the event offers free Pilates classes, local wines, and foods. The race is an ideal program for lovers of vineyards and nature.

name: XI. Ezerjó Félmaraton 5 / 10 / 21
location: Mór, Szent István tér, Mór, Hungary
description: The 11th Ezerjó Half Marathon will be held on May 1, 2026, in Mór, at Szent István Square. The race offers challenges on three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon (21 km). Runners can complete the courses through beautiful vineyards, on varied terrain with inclines and panoramic views. The event is family-friendly, with children's races for the little ones, and participants are rewarded at the finish with refreshments and a finisher medal. The unique atmosphere of the event is provided by the local wine region and community experience.
course_highlights: 5 km course within Mór, minimal inclines, easy terrain
10 km course among vineyards, hilly, varied route
21 km half marathon with long inclines, panoramic view of Csókakő Castle, and downhill sections
additional: The start location is in front of the Mór Mayor's Office. Start times are: half marathon at 10:00, 5 km at 10:05, and 10 km at 10:10. The registration fee includes participation rights, a finisher medal, chip timing, refreshments, a spritz station, coffee, and ice cream at the finish. The race is cup-free, in the spirit of environmental protection. Children's races will also be held in Szent István Park, with separate age groups and awards. Chip timing is available for the half marathon, with a UHF chip attached to the back of the bib. Technical and cotton shirts can be ordered for an additional fee during pre-registration. The course runs through parks and city streets. Pre-registration is open until April 20; on-site registration has higher fees. Children's races are available; finisher medals are not guaranteed for on-site registrations.

name: 50. Komárom-Komárno Nemzetközi Utcai Futóverseny
location: Komárom, Szabadság tér, Komárom-Esztergom megye, Hungary
description: The 50th Komárom-Komárno International Street Running Race is a traditional international race held in one city across two countries. The race offers distances of 5.5 km and 10 km, as well as a children's run, and is open to both certified and recreational runners. The start is at Liberty Square in South Komárom, and the finish is at the sports hall in North Komárom. The race aims to promote running, strengthen the running community, and support a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course runs through the streets of North and South Komárom, crossing two countries within one city
Distances of 5.5 km and 10 km, plus a 200-meter children's run
The finish is at the sports hall in North Komárom
additional: Race packet pickup is available on race day, until 9:15 AM for the 10 km distance and until 9:45 AM for the 5.5 km distance. The children's run is open to children up to 10 years old. The time limit for the race is 1 hour 30 minutes for the 10 km and 45 minutes for the 5.5 km. Results will be announced at 11:30 AM at the sports hall in North Komárom. The registration limit is 1500 participants. Thousands of participants take part in the race, and registration is open until April 25. The race is part of the Komárom Days event series, and the course crosses several points in the city, including Liberty Square and the vicinity of the North Komárom Sports Hall.

name: KOMÁROM – KOMÁRNO FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Komárom-Komárno International Street Running Race is an open, popular race that takes place on the streets of the cities of North and South Komárom, across two countries, in one city. The race offers distances of 5.5 km and 10 km, as well as children's races, welcoming certified and recreational runners. The goal of the race is to promote running, strengthen the sense of community among runners, and support healthy living. The start is at Liberty Square in South Komárom, and the finish line is at the City Sports Hall in North Komárom. The race is traditional, international in nature, and also aims to strengthen cooperation between the two cities.
course_highlights: Street course in the districts of North and South Komárom, across two countries
Distances of 5.5 km and 10 km, as well as children's races
Start point: Liberty Square, South Komárom; Finish: City Sports Hall, North Komárom
additional: Race packet pickup on race day for the 5.5 km distance until 9:45 AM at the latest, and for the 10 km distance until 9:15 AM. The race aims to strengthen the running community and promote healthy lifestyles. The event is sponsored by the mayors of the two cities. Race directors and local race officials ensure organization. The race is scheduled for May 1, 2026; registration is open, and detailed information can be found on the official websites. The race serves as a meeting point for the local community and international runners.

name: FUT AZ ÜLLŐ
description: The "Fut az Üllő" is a traditional city running race held in the town center of Üllő. The aim of the race is to promote sports and community life, and it is open to all age groups. Limited on-site registration is also available on the day of the race from 7:00 AM. The event is organized by the Municipality of Üllő, which ensures its success with the support of the local community.
course_highlights: City center running track
Community and family-friendly event
On-site registration available on race day
additional: Online registration closes at 12:00 PM on April 26, 2024, but limited on-site registration is possible from 7:00 AM on the race day. The race date: 2026-05-01; registration deadline: 2024-04-26; location: City center, Üllő

name: 10 дневно състезание „Шри Чинмой“
location: Парк „Св. Св. Петър и Павел“, София, България
description: The 10-day Sri Chinmoy Race in Sofia is the first certified multi-day race in Bulgaria, held at St. Peter and Paul Park. The race takes place on a 785-meter flat, certified asphalt loop, with each participant competing to cover the maximum distance within 10 days. The event is organized with attention to detail, including official lap counting and strict rules for fairness and safety. Participants can enjoy the atmosphere of the race village and the support of organizers and fellow runners.
course_highlights: 785-meter flat, certified asphalt loop
Held at St. Peter and Paul Park in Sofia
Minimum daily distance of 43.44 km (27 miles)
additional: Every day of the race starts at 8:00 AM. Each participant wears a visible race number at the front. Laps are counted by a judge who changes every six hours. There is also a backup camera system for counting. If a participant interrupts the race or leaves the track, they must inform the judge. It is possible to count a "hotel lap" when leaving and returning to the track at certain points. Consumption of alcohol, smoking, and drug use are prohibited within the camp and on the track. There is a minimum dress code for running and in the park, prohibiting running without upper clothing. Official results are published the next day around 9:00 AM on www.srichinmoyraces.bg. Terrain: asphalt track, 785 m; registration until April 1, 2026; personal helper fee 35 euros/day; vegetarian meals and medical assistance included.

name: ZARA ULTRA TRAIL RUN & XCM CYCLING / Великденски Маратон 2026
organizer: СНЦ Клуб за колоездене и туризъм „Зарата“
price_range: от €14 до €31, в зависимост от категорията и датата на регистрация

description: ZARA ULTRA TRAIL RUN & XCM CYCLING / Easter Marathon 2026 is a sports event in Stara Zagora, which includes mountain running and mountain biking. Organized by the Non-Profit Association Cycling and Tourism Club "Zarata" with the support of the Municipality of Stara Zagora and the Tourist Association "Sarnena Gora", the competition offers various distances for running and cycling in Ayazmo Park. Participants must have valid insurance and sign a liability waiver. The event begins with registration and briefing from 07:00 to 08:00, and the awards ceremony is at 17:00.
course_highlights: Mountain running and mountain biking in Ayazmo Park
Running distances: 5 km, 11 km, 21 km, 32 km, and 38 km (ultra)
Cycling with eBike MTB up to 27 km/h on the 38 km ultra trail
additional: Registration and distribution of start numbers from 07:00 to 08:00. Mandatory helmet use for cyclists. Payment is only via bank transfer or at EasyPay cash desks after online registration. Participants must have valid accident insurance for the day of the event (except UCI cardholders). Awards at 17:00 for both disciplines. Cycling routes will include approximately 32 km hobby trail and 42 km ultra trail; online registration, bank transfer payment; requirement for valid insurance and wearing a helmet for cyclists.

name: Sălciua Trail Run
location: Sălciua de Jos, Alba County, Romania
description: Sălciua Trail Run 2026 este o competiție de alergare în natură desfășurată în comuna Sălciua, situată între Munții Trascău și Muntele Mare, oferind o priveliște spectaculoasă. Evenimentul reunește pasionați de alergare, natură, cultură și distracție, fiind o oportunitate de a evada din cotidian și de a te bucura de frumusețea naturii în compania celor dragi. Competiția include patru curse: Cursa Zmeilor (28 km), Crosul Liliecilor (15 km), Family and Young Run (5 km) și Cursa Spiridușilor (400-800 m), deschise tuturor participanților care respectă condițiile de vârstă și înscriere. Organizatorii asigură o experiență completă, cu kituri de concurs, festivitate de premiere și ateliere tematice pentru toate vârstele.
course_highlights: Trasee prin rezervații naturale, dealuri și pășuni
Zone cu cascade și peșteri unice în zonă
Cadru natural între Munții Trascău și Muntele Mare, altitudine 700-1400 m
additional: Predare kituri în ziua cursei între 07:00-08:30. Starturi în ordine: Crosul Liliecilor (15 km) la 09:00, Family and Young Run (5 km) la 09:30, Cursa Spiridușilor (400-800 m) la 10:00. Festivitatea de premiere începe la ora 13:00. Evenimentul include ateliere tematice pentru copii și adulți în momentele de pauză. Participarea include diverse categorii de curse, cu detalii despre condițiile de înscriere și program, toate programate pentru luna mai 2026.

name: Chindia City Race
location: Piața Tricolorului, Târgoviște, Dâmbovița County, Romania
description: Chindia City Race este o alergare tradițională organizată în inima Cetății Târgoviștei, chiar lângă emblematicul Turn al Chindiei. Evenimentul are loc pe 2 mai 2026, în Piața Tricolorului, și adună participanți de toate vârstele, într-o atmosferă de sărbătoare și competiție prietenoasă. Startul este programat la ora 10:00, iar cursa celebrează spiritul și istoria orașului, invitând alergătorii să-și testeze viteza și rezistența pe un traseu urban plin de energie și tradiție.
course_highlights: Startul în Piața Tricolorului, în centrul istoric al Târgoviștei
Traseu urban cu peisaje ale Cetății și Turnului Chindiei
Eveniment dedicat tuturor categoriilor de vârstă și niveluri de pregătire
additional: Zona de start este în Piața Tricolorului, Târgoviște. Evenimentul are o atmosferă festivă și este deschis tuturor, cu recomandarea de a veni cu încălțări adecvate și suflare zdravănă. Evenimentul face parte din Carpat Race și este susținut de comunitatea locală, fiind o oportunitate de a promova sănătatea și activitatea fizică în Târgoviște.

name: Még egy kört / Încă o rundă - Trail challenge
location: Világlátó, Sfântu Gheorghe, Covasna County, Romania
description: Még egy kört este o provocare de trail running ce are loc la marginea orașului Sfântu Gheorghe, într-un teren împădurit și deluros cunoscut sub numele de „Világlátó”. Participanții pot alege să alerge sau să practice Nordic Walking timp de 2, 4 sau 6 ore, încercând să parcurgă cât mai multe ture de 1,6 km cu o diferență de nivel de +60 m. Evenimentul este conceput ca o provocare mentală și fizică, oferind o atmosferă plăcută cu muzică și bar la fața locului. Este o oportunitate excelentă pentru iubitorii de alergare și nu numai să se testeze într-un cadru natural și prietenos.
course_highlights: Teren împădurit și deluros cunoscut ca „Világlátó”
Tură de 1,6 km cu +60 m diferență de nivel
Provocare de 2, 4 sau 6 ore cu opțiune Nordic Walking
additional: Se oferă bastoane pentru Nordic Walking în număr limitat, pe bază de cerere prin email. La fața locului va fi muzică și Wunderbar. Fiecare participant primește un pachet de start cu număr de concurs și alte materiale promoționale. Evenimentul este o combinație de alergare și provocare mentală, cu posibilitatea de a parcurge cât mai multe ture în intervalul ales. Trail challenge cu bucle de 1,6 km, opțiuni pentru alergare sau Nordic walking, parte a evenimentului Szent György Napok.

name: II. Mohácsi Gőcze Trail
description: The II. Mohácsi Gőcze Trail is a recreational running race scheduled to take place on May 2, 2026, in Mohács, at the Szőlőhegyi event area. The race runs along the trails of the Mohácsi Hills and offers various distances for all age groups, from a 500-meter children's run to a 22 km race. The event is family-friendly, with medical support and prizes, and participants can measure their time with chip timing. Runners can participate in a group warm-up before the start, and participation is at their own risk.
course_highlights: Trails of the Mohácsi Hills
Distances from 500 m to 22 km, suitable for all ages
Start and finish at the Szőlőhegyi event area
additional: Chip timing with a deposit fee of 2000 HUF. Prizes awarded to the top three finishers in each distance and gender. Finish medals are given to children's race participants. Registration is online, with payment via bank transfer. Registration modifications can be made by contacting fussajovodert@gmail.com. Littering is prohibited; violations will result in disqualification. In case of extreme weather, the event may be postponed. Terrain: trails of the Mohácsi Hills; Registration: online, through the Facebook event; chip timing, prizes, medical support, children's races.

name: FARKASMÁLYI DŰLŐ- ÉS PINCEFUTÁS
location: Gyöngyös Farkasmályi pincesor, Gyöngyös, Heves County, Hungary
organizer: Gyöngyösi Triatlon Klub, Farkasmályi Borpincék Egyesület
description: The Farkasmály Dűlő and Cellar Run is a special running race held on the Farkasmály wine road in Gyöngyös, scheduled for May 2, 2026. Participants will run among beautiful vineyards and wine cellars on varied terrain with small inclines. The event features a shorter, less hilly circuit and a longer circuit with greater elevation changes, allowing everyone to choose the distance suitable for them. The race is organized by the GYÖTRI Club, one of the region's prominent sports associations.
course_highlights: Dűlő Circuit: 3000 m, 40 m elevation, 2 laps, among vineyards and wine cellars
Farkasmály Circuit: 8500 m, 190 m elevation, 4 laps, hilly terrain and cellar visits
Relay race and spritz run for teams, with special wine spritz stations
additional: Registration and bib pickup from 13:00, on-site registration closes 15 minutes before each race start. Parking is available on the grassy area next to Szilue Hotel. Race distances: Dűlő Circuit (2 laps), Farkasmály Circuit (4 laps), 4x1500 m relay race, spritz run for teams of 3, with 800 m and 4 spritz stations (wine or must spritz). The course passes through cellars at the end of each lap, ascending a small hill towards the finish line. Trail running, routes between cellars, wine tasting, pre-registration and on-site registration, awards, open cellars, refreshments, and results announcement.

name: MOHÁCSI GÖCZE TRAIL (2.)
location: Mohácsi Szőlőhegyi rendezvénytér, Mohács, Baranya County, Hungary
description: The Mohácsi Gőcze Trail is a trail running race held at the Mohácsi Szőlőhegyi event area. Every finisher receives a metal medal, and the top three male and female finishers in each distance receive special awards, including for children's races. The event promotes the power of running and community, offering high quality at low prices for participants. The race covers a distance of 21 km, which also earns Ötpróba points. Organizers emphasize the positive effects of running on physical and mental health.
course_highlights: 21 km trail running distance
Every finisher receives a metal medal
Top three male and female finishers in each distance receive special awards
additional: On-site registration is possible on the day of the race. The race takes place at the Mohácsi Szőlőhegyi event area. It is part of the Ötpróba program, earning 4 points for the 21 km distance. Awards are also given in children's races. Distances: 500 m, 1 km, 6 km, 10.5 km, 22 km; location: Mohács, Szőlőhegyi event area; online and on-site registration; medical insurance; children's races; weather-dependent changes.

name: MaricaRUN
description: MaricaRUN 2026 is a unique sporting event featuring distances of 5 and 10 kilometers, as well as a 1 km children's run, held in the beautiful Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. The race combines sport, emotions, and a charitable cause, with 40% of the entry fees donated to charity. The route is flat, suitable for all levels, and passes through the most beautiful parts of the park with views of the Maritsa River. Participants will enjoy a well-organized route with refreshment stations and a festive atmosphere with prizes and sports demonstrations.
course_highlights: Flat route suitable for all levels
Passes along the Maritsa River and relaxation zones with water views
10 km route consists of 2 laps around the park
additional: Start packages can be collected in advance on May 1st from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day. Races are on May 2nd: 10 km at 10:00, 5 km at 10:15, and a 1 km children's run at 10:20. An award ceremony will take place at 11:40. 40% of the entry fees are donated to charity. Participants receive medals, and winners receive cups, vouchers, and gifts. There will be sports demonstrations, physical challenges, and a raffle with prizes. The course runs through Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. Registration is online or on-site, and participants receive medals and the chance to win prizes. Places are limited.

name: Коджа Кая
location: село Билка, район връх Коджа Кая, България
description: Kozha Kaya is Bulgaria's first fully autonomous ultramarathon, held in the village of Bilka, in the Kozha Kaya peak area. The race offers various distances with significant positive elevation gains and no support stations, making it a true test of endurance and skills. Participants are challenged to finish before sunset, enjoying stunning views and natural beauty. This is an event for adventure and mountain running enthusiasts, leaving a lifelong memory.
course_highlights: 75 km with 4400 m positive elevation gain and full autonomy
42 km marathon with over 2700 m positive elevation gain without support stations
30 km Sky with 1950 m positive elevation gain and full autonomy
additional: All distances are with full autonomy, without support stations. There is an additional challenge - a speed ascent of Kozha Kaya 3.6 km with 500 m positive elevation gain. The event takes place in a natural environment rich in flora and fauna, offering breathtaking views and challenging terrains. The race is scheduled for May 1-2, 2026, with participants able to choose between different distances suitable for both experienced runners and amateurs. Registration is available on the official website.

name: МарицаРън 2026
location: Димитровград, Парк Марица, Димитровград, Хасково, България
description: MaritsaRun 2026 is a professionally organized race suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The event offers three distances - 1 km for children up to 14 years old, 5 km for a fun sports challenge, and 10 km for a greater personal achievement. The course passes through the most beautiful parts of Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad, including alleys, the river, relaxation zone, and art installations. Participants will enjoy a good atmosphere with music, an audience, and support along the route, as well as prizes and recognition with a prize fund of over 1500 euros.
course_highlights: The course passes through the main entrance, alleys, the river, relaxation zone, and art installations of Maritsa Park
Distances: 1 km children's run, 5 km and 10 km for adults
Hydration stations and support along the route
additional: Registration is possible online or on-site on the day of the event if there are available starting numbers. Late registration is possible after 15.04.2026. Medals for all finishers and monetary and material prizes for the winners. The event features music, professional photographers, and a festive atmosphere. Registration is online or on-site, with late registration after 15.04. The event includes a children's run and routes in Maritsa Park, supporting a healthy lifestyle and community.

name: 24. Öntúlszárnyalás maraton
description: The 24th Overshoot Marathon will be held on May 3, 2026, at Lake Malomvölgy in Pécs. This running race, organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, has a friendly atmosphere and features a loop course that allows participants to complete marathon and half-marathon distances. The course is forested, compacted earth and crushed stone, with a 30-meter elevation change, offering varied terrain for competitors. Chip timing ensures accurate results, and refreshment stations provide abundant supplies.
course_highlights: 5.2 km loop course, with the marathon consisting of 8 laps
Forested, compacted earth and crushed stone paths, with 30 meters of elevation change
Combination of the lakeside walking trail and designated course
additional: Chip timing is on the back of the bib. Refreshment station at the start/finish line offers isotonic drinks, water, sweet and salty biscuits, sandwiches, fruits, vegetables, and chocolate. Participant limit: maximum 250 people. T-shirt available for an additional 3,500 HUF, order by April 15. Time limits: 5.2 km - 50 minutes, 10.4 km - 1 hour 40 minutes, half-marathon - 3 hours, marathon - 6 hours. Bib and T-shirt pickup on race day between 7:00 and 7:45, with on-site registration also available. Multiple distances, forest course, chip timing, on-site and online registration, limited capacity (max 250), time limits and fees per distance, accommodation options nearby.

name: Farkasmályi Dűlő és Pince futás
organizer: Gyöngyösi Triatlon Klub, Farkasmályi Borpincék Egyesület
description: The Farkasmály Dűlő and Cellar Run is a scenic trail running race in Gyöngyös along the Farkasmály vineyard row, taking place among vineyards and wine cellars. The race offers multiple distances, including a shorter, less hilly 3 km loop and a longer, 8.5 km loop with ascents. Runners can enjoy close contact with nature, cellar visits, and varied terrain suitable for both beginners and advanced runners. The event is organized by GYÖTRI Club, which has decades of experience in organizing sports events.
course_highlights: Dűlő-loop: 3000 m, 40 m elevation, 2 laps among the vineyards with cellar visits
Farkasmályi-loop: 8500 m, 190 m elevation, 4 laps with ascents and cellar visits
Relay race 4x1500 m and Spritz Run for teams of 3 with 800 m distance and spritz stations
additional: Registration and bib pickup from 13:00, on-site registration closes a quarter of an hour before the start of each race. Parking is available on the grassy area next to Szilue Hotel. The race location coordinates: 47.805908, 19.955025. Registration for the race is open from April 10 to April 30. Participants can look forward to awards and wine tasting.

name: MÁSODSZOR IS CÉLBA ÉRÜNK!
description: Koraszülöttfutás 2026 is a charity running event that starts from Zalaegerszeg and ends in Keszthely, covering a total distance of 66 km. During the run, participants pass through beautiful Zala landscapes, with ten relay points, and the entire distance is tracked with chip timing. The event prominently supports premature babies, for whom a relay run is also part of the program. At the finish line, teams can arrive together to share the experience and success. The start and pasta party are held at the Zala Zone Vehicle Testing Track, and the run takes place on Sunday, May 3.
course_highlights: 66 km distance between Zalaegerszeg and Keszthely
10 relay and refreshment points at the Göcsej Village Museum
Route marked with small bear symbols and ribbons approximately every 200 meters
additional: Time measurement is done using a chip placed on the bib. The total time limit for the distance is 8 hours 30 minutes. A pasta party will be held on May 2 at 17:00 at the Zala Zone Vehicle Testing Track. The route crosses two railway crossings, with participants passing through the first under escort by medical personnel. The relay run for premature babies takes place on May 3 at 16:00 from the Keszthely Castle Park to the Main Square. The event includes several related activities such as registration, race packet pickup, relay points, and finishing, with options for individual or team registration.

name: Mechi Chal Trail Chepelare
price_range: 15 € до 30 € за участие, 20 € за тениска на събитието
description: Mechi Chal Trail is an exciting mountain race taking place on May 3, 2026, in Chepelare, at the Olympic Square. The courses pass through mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The race offers three distances with varying elevation gains, challenging participants with true mountain terrain. Every finisher receives a medal, and the winners are awarded cash and material prizes.
course_highlights: Mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains
Distances with positive elevation gain from 420 m to 1640 m
Start and finish at the Olympic Square in Chepelare
additional: Start packages are distributed on May 2 from 15:00 to 20:00 at Borika Hotel and on May 3 from 8:00 at the Olympic Square. Participants under 16 years old can only participate in the 7.6 km distance. Every finisher receives a medal, and prizes for the top three places include cash and material awards. It is recommended to fill out participation declarations in advance. Payment at the moment is only via bank transfer. The distances include 7.6 km, 15 km, and 30 km with positive elevation gains of 420 m, 820 m, and 1640 m respectively; start and finish at the Olympic Square in Chepelare; the courses are in mountain and forest terrains.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване и спускане мъже и жени, под 20 г., под 18г., под 16г.
description: The National Mountain Running Championship - uphill and downhill for men and women, as well as for boys and girls under 20, under 18, and under 16, is held in Chepelare. The competition offers a challenging mountain terrain that tests the endurance and skills of the participants. This is an important sports event in the Bulgarian athletics calendar, attracting both young and experienced runners. The organizers provide professional organization and support for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with uphill and downhill sections
Categories for men, women, and boys and girls under 20, 18, and 16
Held in the picturesque area of Chepelare
additional: For all inquiries, participants should contact the organizer directly at the provided email. The event is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and is officially supported. It is included in the national mountain running calendar and offers participation opportunities across various age groups.

name: 2. E.ON Business Run
description: The E.ON Business Run is a special running event held at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. The race aims to bring together corporate participants and all interested individuals for a shared experience of movement, where individual and team spirit are both celebrated. Runners can choose from three distances: 5 km individual run, a 3-person relay (3x2.7 km), and a 2 km stadium walk. The event is accompanied by music, parties, and street food, ensuring an unforgettable experience for participants after the run.
course_highlights: The iconic running track of the National Athletics Centre
Three different distances: 5 km individual, 3x2.7 km relay, 2 km stadium walk
Running near the Danube, stadium experience, and lively party atmosphere
additional: Participants can pay by bank card and SZÉP card. Registration requires a BSI account registration. Finishers receive a unique finisher medal. After the race, a lively party with music and street food awaits participants. In the 3-person relay, each runner completes approximately 2.7 km. The event also offers free e-training and charity opportunities. Distances: 5 km, 3x2.7 km relay, 2 km stadium walk. The event location is the National Athletics Centre, Budapest. Participation is possible through online and on-site registration.

name: E.ON BUSINESS RUN
description: The E.ON Business Run is a special running event scheduled for May 6, 2026, at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. The race welcomes not only corporate participants but also anyone interested in moving, competing, and having fun together. The event features three distances: a 5 km individual race, a relay race with three members (3x2.7 km), and a 2 km stadium walk. Participants receive a unique finisher medal at the finish line, and the atmosphere is enhanced with music, street food, and an evening party.
course_highlights: The iconic track of the National Athletics Centre
3 distances: 5 km individual, 3x2.7 km relay, 2 km stadium walk
Unique location by the Danube River
additional: Online registration is only possible with a bank card and SZÉP card. Registration requires BSI account registration. Finishers receive a unique finisher medal. The event features music, street food, and an evening party. Registration office contact details are available on the website. The event offers music, street food, and a festive atmosphere; the venue is the National Athletics Centre, where community programs also take place alongside the run.

name: РЕКОРД НА ХАЙДУШКАТА ПЪТЕКА 2026
description: Heidiushka Path Record 2026 is an annual race held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven. Participants compete in climbing the iconic trail from the start to the large fountain near the Karanli Hotel, with various route options of different difficulty levels. The race is for prestige, with no categories or prize fund, and results are officially recorded and published for each participant who completes the trail in under 1 hour. This is a unique challenge for mountain running and nature enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Climbing the iconic Heidiushka Path in Sinite Kamani Nature Park
Route with various variations - the shortest is the steepest and most difficult
Finish at the large fountain near Karanli Hotel
additional: The race has no categories, age restrictions, or prize fund. Only the time from start to finish is measured. The record holder's name is inscribed on a special plaque at the beginning of the trail. Participants with times under 1 hour have their results published on the Foundation "Stari Bryast" website. The event includes trail running with different routes and no categories or prizes, emphasizing personal achievements and records.

name: ЮНАШКИ ИГРИ 2026
description: Yunashki Games 2026 are held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven on May 6th, in honor of Haji Dimitar's birthday and Gergyovden - the Day of Bravery. The event is dedicated to the traditions and spirit of the hajduks, including games and competitions that they used to measure their strength when choosing a voivode. The course and atmosphere are connected to the region's historical heritage and the natural beauty of Sinite Kamani. It is organized by the Old Oak Foundation, which works to preserve the cultural heritage and nature of Sliven.
course_highlights: Held in Sinite Kamani Nature Park with alpine-type terrain
The course passes along ancient hajduk trails and near 14 ancient and medieval fortresses
A place with numerous rocky peaks, steep slopes, caves, and waterfalls
additional: The event is part of the traditional patriotic causes of the Old Oak Foundation, held in honor of historical figures and events related to the hajduks and Bulgarian history. Registration and briefing take place at the Information Center of Sinite Kamani Nature Park; competitions include stone throwing and knife throwing; participants in folk costumes are encouraged.

name: Pusztafutás 1 / 5 / 11
description: The Pusztafutás is a friendly, family-oriented trail running race held annually since 2016 in Solt Szőlőhegy. The race offers multiple distances for both children and adults, with a varied and exciting route that features hilly and interesting terrain rather than the usual flat plains of the puszta. Finishers receive a unique, connectable finisher medal, and on-site services include parking, a refreshment stand, and a playhouse. The goal of the event is to provide an experience for all age groups and to be a comprehensive event for runners.
course_highlights: Varied, exciting terrain on the western edge of Kiskunság
580-meter secured route with minimal elevation change
Start center at Szőlőhegy, next to Krammer Pince
additional: The race will only be held if at least 100 valid registrations are received by the end of the first registration period. A maximum of 400 runners can register, including up to 100 in the preschool and lower elementary categories. Accompanying parents cannot physically assist their child's run and do not need to register separately. Participants can choose to register without a medal at a lower price. On-site facilities include parking, restrooms, a playhouse, first aid station, and a refreshment stand. The race will not be held in 2026 due to insufficient registrations to meet the minimum required by the organizers.

name: Columbia Sunset Trail
description: The Columbia Sunset Trail is an exciting trail running race held at sunset around the Naszály Mountain. Participants receive a unique wooden finisher medal, and the top three male and female finishers in each distance will be awarded special prizes. The event offers plentiful refreshment stations, changing rooms, and baggage storage, with runners advised to use headlamps and hydration packs. The atmosphere of the race and the proximity to nature guarantee an unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Running at sunset around Naszály Mountain
Unique wooden finisher medal for all distances
Abundant refreshments at aid stations and finish line
additional: Free, cool photos available the day after the race. Changing rooms and baggage storage at the base. Headlamp use is mandatory, in working condition, charged. Mobile phones should be fully charged, turned on, and on loudspeaker. Hydration packs, bottles, or cups are required, as disposable cups will not be available at aid stations and the finish. Trail running event with excellent organization and participant services, including photos, prizes, and gear recommendations.

name: COLUMBIA SUNSET TRAIL
location: Naszály, Bocskai utca 1, Naszály, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Columbia Sunset Trail is an exciting trail running race taking place at sunset in the picturesque surroundings of Naszály. Participants will receive a unique wooden finisher medal for each distance, and the top finishers will be awarded special medals. The event offers plentiful refreshment stations, changing rooms, and baggage storage. It is recommended to use a headlamp and hydration pack for safe completion. The atmosphere of the race and the proximity to nature guarantee an unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Running at sunset in the natural environment of Naszály
Unique wooden finisher medal for all distances
Abundant refreshments at aid stations and finish line
additional: Free, cool photos available the day after the race. Special medals awarded to the top three male and female finishers in each distance. Changing rooms and baggage storage available at the base. Headlamp usage is mandatory, in working condition and fully charged. Mobile phone must be charged, turned on, operational, and loud. Using a hydration pack, bottle, or cup is recommended, as disposable cups will not be available at aid stations and the finish. A personal ID or readable copy is required for registration. Trail running event offering plentiful provisions, safety equipment, and memorable experiences for participants.

name: Subcarpați Trail Run
location: Baza Sportivă „Stejarul”, Cocorăștii Mislii, Prahova, Romania
distance_verbose: 50 mile, Maraton, Maraton, 23 km, Semimaraton, Semimaraton, 5 km
