description: The Full Moon Run is a night race in Esztergom, taking place along the scenic routes of Várhegy, Víziváros, and the riverside bike path. The race offers three distances: 4 km, 10 km, and 15 km, with the 15 km route also passing through Prímás-sziget. Participants are required to wear a headlamp or other lighting device, as some parts of the course are unlit. The event is organized by the Esztergomi Futóművek Amateur Sports Club and is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program.
course_highlights: Esztergom Várhegy, Víziváros, and riverside bike path route
15 km distance passing through Prímás-sziget
Cobblestone sections and unlit bike path segments
additional: A functioning headlamp or other lighting device is mandatory for the race. The participant limit is 200 per distance. The event is a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program, awarding 1 point for the 4 km, 2 points for the 10 km, and 3 points for the 15 km. Online registration confirmation will be sent as an attachment to the email receipt, while on-site registration results will be available within 5 days after the race. T-shirt sizes and ECO registration options without a T-shirt, with an old medal, are available. Race details include terrain conditions, registration information, and event rules; additionally, the event is part of the Ötpróba program.

name: Troyan Run
location: Troyan, Troyan Municipality, Lovech Province, Bulgaria
distance_verbose: 70 km, Маратон, 28 km, 12 km, 5 km, 3000 метра
description: TroyanRun is mountain running event held in the Troyan Balkan, dedicated to the cause of Vasil Levski. The competition offers various routes with different levels of difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain running enthusiasts. The organizers are the association "Troyan in the Future," which works to promote the historical and natural heritage and encourage a healthy lifestyle through sports. The event also includes a street art festival and charitable initiatives.
course_highlights: Routes of different lengths: 3 km, 6 km, 12 km, 28 km, 42 km, and 70 km with varying elevation
Mountain terrain in the Troyan Balkan with natural and historical landmarks
Opportunity to participate for both professionals and amateurs
additional: Start packages are received on-site with priority given to longer distances. It is mandatory to wear a race number, carry a water bottle or hydration system (minimum 500 ml), and have a mobile phone with the organizers' contact number. The program includes a technical conference and an award ceremony. Multiple distances, historical theme, mountain running, charitable initiatives, routes with panoramic views, events for an active lifestyle.

name: Вършец ултра
description: Vârșeț Ultra is a mountain running event offering a variety of distances suitable for both experienced ultramarathon runners and beginners, including children. The event takes place in the beautiful natural environment of Vârșeț, with the start located in front of the Medicus Hotel. Participants can choose between an ultra distance of 48 km and shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. This race combines sport, nature, and the opportunity for active relaxation in the Vârșeț national resort.
course_highlights: Mountain running with diverse distances
Start in front of Medicus Hotel in Vârșeț
Routes through picturesque natural environment
additional: Registration package available at Vârșeț municipality. Distances: ultra 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Dates: July 12-13, 2026. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Start from Medicus Hotel. Online registration.

name: Камчийски пясъци
description: Kamchiyski Piasatsi is a unique running event held on July 4, 2026, on Bulgaria's longest beach strip between Kamchia Holiday Resort and Shkorpilovtsi. The course is entirely sandy and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River with safety measures and auxiliary equipment provided. The race offers two main distances - 10 km and 21.1 km, as well as a children's run of 2.2 km. The organizer is the 'Green Step' club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.
course_highlights: The course is entirely sandy and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River
Distances are 10 km and 21.1 km with refreshment points approximately every 5 km
Opportunity to run barefoot and safety measures are provided for river crossing
additional: The start is in the evening, with race numbers distributed from 15:00 and luggage storage available. Cut-off time is 4 hours for 21.1 km and 3:30 hours for 10 km. Children can participate free of charge in the 2.2 km children's run. Participants are required to carry a water container for refreshment points. Timing is with RFID chips. In adverse conditions, crossing the river may be done by boats provided by the organizers. Distances include 10 km and 21.1 km, with refreshment points every approximately 5 km, online registration options, fees via EasyPay or ePay, and options for accompaniment and children under 7 years with a guardian.

name: HAAS MARATON VÁLTÓ
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The HAAS Marathon Relay is a traditional relay race organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Club. The event combines the excitement of relay running with the proximity of nature, allowing participants to test their strength on varied terrain around Tata. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and offers an engaging program for both runners and spectators. It is open to sports enthusiasts and amateur runners alike and is an important event in the local sports scene.
course_highlights: Relay running on varied terrain around Tata
Nature-oriented course with forest and agricultural sections
Family-friendly, friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race is organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Club, which supports multiple sports. The event is part of the Sprint Running Club's activities, with several sections traditionally involved in organizing. Maps and previous results are available on the website, but specific prices or start times are not listed on the provided page. In addition to relay running, the event offers other sports activities, with detailed registration and participation information available on the organizer's website.

name: Вършец рън
description: Vâršeț Run and Vâršeț Ultra is a mountain running event offering a variety of distances suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, including children. The event takes place in the picturesque resort of Vâršeț, with the start line in front of the Medicus Hotel. The routes include an ultra distance of 48 km, as well as shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners, providing opportunities for participation at different levels. Registration is done through the platform runbulgaria.org, and start packages are received in the municipality of Vâršeț.
course_highlights: Mountain running with an ultra distance of 48 km
Short mountain routes of 11.6 km and 5.9 km
Children's and beginner's distance of 1 km
additional: The start is in front of the Medicus Hotel. The start package is received in the municipality of Vâršeț. Registration is via the platform runbulgaria.org. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners; start in front of the Medicus Hotel; registration at www.runbulgaria.org.

name: Stâna de Vale Trail Race
description: Stâna de Vale Trail Race este o competiție de alergare montană ce se desfășoară în peisajele spectaculoase ale Munților Carpați, în stațiunea Stâna de Vale, județul Bihor. Evenimentul face parte din circuitul EMA Off-Road Running 2026 și oferă curse pentru toate nivelurile, de la trasee pentru începători până la ultramaratoane montane solicitante. Participanții se pot bucura de trasee bine marcate, asistență completă pe parcurs și o atmosferă prietenoasă după cursă. Weekendul de concurs include și o cursă verticală de 8 km, o cursă clasică de 11 km și o cursă lungă de 33 km cu diferențe mari de nivel.
course_highlights: Traseu montan de 33 km cu 1500 m diferență de nivel pozitivă, cu secțiuni tehnice și priveliști panoramice
Traseu de 11 km potrivit pentru începători și alergători intermediari, prin păduri și dealuri domoale
Cursă verticală de 8 km cu 1100 m diferență de nivel, cu urcare continuă și solicitantă
additional: Evenimentul se desfășoară pe 10-11 iulie 2026, cu ridicarea pachetelor de concurs la Hotel Iadolina, Stâna de Vale. Cursa Vertical 8K începe vineri la ora 10:00, iar cursele de 33 km și 11 km încep sâmbătă la 08:30 și 09:30. Organizatorii oferă masă după cursă și o petrecere de după festivitatea de premiere. Participarea în circuitul EMA este condiționată de deținerea unei licențe valide pentru categoria de vârstă 35-79 ani. Traseele sunt în teren montan, iar evenimentul include cronometrare. Participanții pot alege între două distanțe pentru a se potrivi nivelului lor de pregătire.

name: Zalău Ultra Trail
description: Zalău Ultra Trail este o competiție de alergare montană ce se desfășoară pe parcursul a trei zile în inima Munților Sălajului. Evenimentul oferă o varietate de curse pentru toate nivelurile, de la copii la alergători experimentați, inclusiv o cursă ultra de 103 km cu o diferență de nivel de peste 5000 m. ZUT este mai mult decât o competiție, fiind o platformă care unește atleți, comunitatea locală și natura, promovând spiritul de aventură și respectul pentru mediul înconjurător. Traseele sunt provocatoare și spectaculoase, oferind o experiență autentică de trail running în peisaje naturale impresionante.
course_highlights: Traseu ULTRA de 103 km cu 5255 m diferență de nivel
Puncte de alimentare și control bine echipate pe traseu
Diversitate de curse: de la 2,5 km pentru copii până la ultra de 103 km
additional: Evenimentul se desfășoară pe 3 zile, cu curse multiple adaptate diferitelor niveluri de pregătire. Cursa Last Man Standing este o competiție specială de anduranță cu ture de 6.7 km la fiecare oră, eliminând participanții care nu termină în timp. Există categorii de premii pentru copii și cursele Cross. Echipamentul obligatoriu este specificat în regulament, iar punctele de alimentare oferă apă, isotonic, fructe și mâncare caldă pe traseul ultra. Multiple race distanțe, inclusiv curse pentru copii și evenimente caritabile; accent pe promovarea valorilor locale și a spiritului comunitar; evenimentul are și o componentă de sensibilizare ecologică.

name: Predeal Forest Run
description: Predeal Forest Run este un eveniment de alergare montană ce se desfășoară în Predeal, Brașov, pe 11 iulie 2026. Evenimentul oferă cinci trasee de trail running potrivite pentru toate nivelurile de pregătire, de la începători la alergători experimentați, cu distanțe variind de la 13 km până la 38 km. Traseele trec prin păduri, poteci montane și zone cu peisaje spectaculoase, oferind o experiență completă de alergare montană. Evenimentul este cunoscut pentru atmosfera prietenoasă și comunitatea activă de alergători, fiind o ocazie excelentă de a descoperi frumusețile muntelui Piatra Mare.
course_highlights: Trasee 100% trail run prin pădure și poteci montane
Urcări provocatoare, inclusiv peste 500 m diferență de nivel pe 4 km la K24
Peisaje spectaculoase de la Poiana Stanei Pietricica, Vf. Piatra Mare și Cabana Garbova
additional: Evenimentul include cinci probe: K13 Cros, K24 Semimaraton, K32 Piatra Mare, K38 Maraton și Family Run (necompetitiv). Startul se dă de la baza pârtiilor Clăbucet. Traseele sunt marcate cu bandă galbenă cu logo Predeal Forest Run roșu și sunt asistate de voluntari. Timpi limita și puncte de alimentare sunt stabilite pentru probele competitive. Kitul de participare va fi anunțat ulterior. Participanții pot înscrie la diverse categorii de curse, iar evenimentul promovează o cauză socială. Detalii despre înscriere și reguli sunt disponibile pe site-ul oficial.

name: VII. Csillagok útján… éjszakai futás
description: The VII. Starry Night Run is a special night run event held at the Platán Beach in Balatonboglár, where runners and walkers are expected on July 11th in the summer Balaton lakeside environment. The new location offers the advantage of a wider start-finish corridor, a solid paved surface throughout, and full lighting along the route. Participants can choose from distances of 3.5 km, 7 km, and 10.5 km, as well as walking and a 500-meter distance for children. The event warmly welcomes all ages and running levels to experience the magic of night running together.
course_highlights: Balatonboglár Platán Beach in a beautiful Balaton lakeside setting
Wide start-finish corridor and solid paved surface
Full lighting along the entire route ensuring a safe night run
additional: Walking is also an option for the 3.5 km distance, and children can compete over 500 meters. Full route lighting ensures safe night running. The new location features a wider start-finish corridor and a solid paved surface. The event is part of Balaton's summer activities, and the organizers aim to increase interest in active leisure activities in the region.

name: DRÁVA FÉLMARATON
location: Barcs, Városháza, Barcs, Somogy County, Hungary
description: The Dráva Half Marathon is a traditional 21-kilometer running race held between Barcs and Heresznye, now in its fifth edition. Participants from several counties take part in the race, which is divided into separate categories for men and women. The route is diverse, and in previous years, record times have been set, demonstrating the race's seriousness and popularity. The event is organized by the local Dráva Running Club and the Heresznye municipality, providing a friendly yet competitive atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer distance between Barcs and Heresznye
Diverse route allowing for record times
Participants from six counties
additional: The event also features multiple sports, including running, hiking, and cycling, and races are generally held in July between Barcs and Heresznye.

name: KÖCSI-TÓ FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Köcsi Lake Running Race is a traditional, family-friendly running event near Balatonalmádi-Káptalanfüred, around the picturesque Köcsi Lake. The race warmly welcomes all who wish to run or walk, allowing participants to enjoy the proximity of nature and the community sports experience. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sport and Environmental Protection Association, which is committed to sports and environmental protection. The race offers multiple distances, so everyone can find a suitable challenge.
course_highlights: Nature-close running track around Köcsi Lake
Family-friendly, community atmosphere
Multiple distances for different age groups
additional: Results are available for 1 km, 6 km, and 12 km distances, categorized by age groups. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sport and Environmental Protection Association, which also supports several health and environmental projects. Participants can access photos on the website. Multiple distances for children and adults, refreshment stations, beach bathing options, finisher medals.
